# Shree Balaji Agro Industries

> Manufacturer of crop protection solutions — insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, and plant growth regulators (PGR) — serving Indian farmers, distributors, and field officers from Dhule, Maharashtra.

Shree Balaji Agro Industries is an agricultural chemicals company offering a tested catalog of pesticides and PGR products along with a multilingual platform (English, Hindi, Marathi) for farmers, distributors, and field officers. The platform includes a product catalog, disease detector, dosage calculator, dealer locator, news and advisories, and sustainability resources.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the company, featured products, and farmer resources.
- [About](/about): Company history, leadership, milestones, and manufacturing capabilities.
- [Products](/products): Full catalog of insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, and PGR products with filters and search.
- [Compare Products](/products/compare): Side-by-side comparison of selected products.
- [Find a Dealer](/find-dealer): Locate authorized distributors by pincode, district, or taluka across India.
- [Contact](/contact): Office address, phone, email, and inquiry form.
- [News](/news): Company announcements, product launches, industry updates, and advisories.
- [Resources](/resources): Articles and guides on crop protection, application techniques, IPM, soil health, and safety.
- [Sustainability](/sustainability): Eco-friendly farming practices and the company's environmental commitments.
- [Safety Hub](/safety): Safety precautions, first-aid information, and best practices for pesticide handling.
- [Pest Calendar](/tools/pest-calendar): Seasonal pest activity calendar for major crops.
- [Harvest Timer](/tools/harvest-timer): PHI (pre-harvest interval) calculator for safe harvesting after spraying.
- [Yield Simulator](/yield-simulator): Estimate crop yield based on inputs and recommended products.
- [Ask AI](/ask-ai): Trilingual AI assistant for farming questions, disease identification, and product recommendations.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Account access for farmers, distributors, field officers, and admins.
